subject: pri-info-td
title: PRI.INFO.TD.------ALT.F.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-18, on the page where Braxton argues that 'creativity is related to functionalism, both with regards to the meta-reality of a given culture group and the actualness of particulars on the physical universe level.' Note: the title abbreviates as PRI.INFO.TD but the actual subject termId in the file is PRI-VT-TD (primary vibrational tendencies) — Braxton uses both expansions in his prose; here it sits as the crossing's subject. (C)PRI-VT-TD is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism). Two upstream feeds: IST-PT (isolated particulars) → INFO-OR (information order) → PRI-VT-TD; and INFO-CON (information convergence) → PRI-VT-TD directly. The subject outputs to ALT-F (the crossing) and to AFI (affinity insight). ALT-F then branches to RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) → SOC-RT (social reality), and to RE-ST (restructuralism) → FUND-DYN (fundamental dynamics). Structural argument: primary vibrational tendencies are produced by the convergence of isolated-particulars and information-convergence, and their alternative-functional output requires *two parallel routes* — one through reality-initiative-traits into social reality, one through restructuralism into fundamental dynamics. Affinity insight is a *separate* terminal output. The diagram thus diagrams the *prerequisite* structure for alternative functionalism: it cannot be willed into being from a single upstream — it requires the dual convergence Braxton names in the surrounding prose.
